stay.notes: Winter closure, not a data gap: the Gurez-Bandipora road over Razdan Pass was closed to all but emergency vehicles after the first snow on 5 Nov 2025 (https://www.greaterkashmir.com/latest-news/fresh-snowfall-forces-closure-of-gurez-bandipora-road-authorities-urge-travellers-to-confirm-status-before-journey/), and was shut again on 22 Jan 2025 (https://kashmirreader.com/2025/01/22/traffic-suspended-on-gurez-bandipora-road/); travel guides give May-October as the open season (https://travelmykashmir.com/best-time-to-visit-gurez-valley/).
